column3: “From a bow” is rendered “without the bow,” and NASB adds “Though.”
“Chariotry of a man” is rendered “chariots, infantry.”
“Covering” is rendered “defense,” and “looked to” as “depended on.”
NASB supplies “you,” and “baldness” is rendered “shaving the head.”
“In my ears” is rendered “to me,” and “if it will be atoned for” (oath form) as “Surely … shall not be forgiven.”
“Over the house” is rendered “in charge of the royal household.”
The change to the third person (“his tomb”) is rendered as direct address, “You who hew.”
“Of both hands” is rendered “vast,” and NASB adds “To be cast.”
“He will tear down” is rendered “I will pull down.”
“A seat of honor” is rendered “a throne of glory.”
